question:
Select the correct mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is placed at XY as shown.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/538a91db4900f46df5314ff718cae178945b42df963383b5121becc871b7eeac.png]
solution:
Correct answer is an **option(3)**

When the mirror is placed vertically to the object, then the image formed will be laterally inverted. In other words, the Left-Hand Side and Right Hand Side interchange their positions while the top and bottom will remain the same.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fbfc7a1aed7a683f3e04f0dd6dbbf5aa1144b4187d41340bee5c81031660edd2.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is an **option(3).**
